secs.t: 爸妈最常使用的50句英文
p: Don't be picky about your food.
Wash your face and brush your teeth.
What do you want to wear today?
Did you put some lotion on your face?
Hurry up, honey! You'll be late.
Here's the elevator. Let's get in.
Press the button for the first floor.
今天在学校过得怎么样？
Are you done with your homework?
Did you do well on your test?
What score did you get on the test?
Do you want a piggy-back ride?
Do you want me to hold you?
Don't fight with your little brother/sister.
Let me read you a story.
It's time to go to bed.
Don't forget that I love you.

secs.t: 孩子最常使用的50句英文
p: 爸，祝你有个美好的一天！
I want to wear this shirt.
I can do it by myself.
Mom, I'm all grown up now.
Can you get me the scissors, Mom?
Can I play computer games for a little bit?
我可以玩一会电脑游戏吗？
Can I go play at Jina's house?
I want to try it, Mommy!
I'm sorry. It won't happen again.
Can you get me milk, please?
你可以把牛奶拿给我吗？拜托了。
Can I have some ice cream?
Hold me tight. / Give me a big hug.
Dad, when are you coming home?
Can you read me a story, Mom?
妈，可以讲个故事给我听吗？
Who do you love more, me or Minji?
你爱谁多一点，我还是敏智？
I love you the most in the world.
在这个世界上，我最爱你了。
Get up, please! Time to go to school.
I'll tickle you if you don't wake up.
再不起床的话，我要抓痒痒了。
You should go to bed early to get up early.
I'm so tired that I can't get up.
Mom, I can't keep my eyes open!
I'll count to three. Come on!
Hurry up, or you will be late.
You don't have to wake me up. I'm already up.
你不用叫我也没关系。我已经醒了。
Wow! Did you get up by yourself?
Did you not hear the alarm?
Don't doze off. Sit up straight.
Let's see who gets up first.
I'm not going to wake you up anymore.
以后我不会再叫你起床了。
Hey! Did you get a good night's sleep?
Did you sleep tight, my sweetie?
You're already awake? Why so early?
已经醒了哦？为什么这么早醒呢？
Whoa! I've never seen this before!
Seems like you're in a good mood.
You look happy after a good night's sleep.
睡个好觉后，你看起来心情很好。
Why do you look grumpy this morning?
为什么今天早上你看起来心情不太好？
You should say hello first thing in the morning.
起床后，你应该先打招呼。
Mom, want to hear about my dreams?
妈妈，要听听我做的梦吗？
Can you wake up your brother?
你可以叫你弟弟起床吗？
Get up to wash your face.
Wash your face and brush your teeth.
Who wants to wash up first?
If I do it by myself, I will get my clothes wet.
自己洗的话，我会弄湿衣服的。
I don't want to clean my face!
I'll wash myself after I eat.
Mom, can you get me a towel?
妈，可以拿条毛巾给我吗？
洗好后，你看起来好美哦。
Watch out for the slippery floor.
You should brush your teeth three times a day.
Don't forget to brush the back teeth.
不要忘记也要刷里面的牙哦。
Clean your teeth and gums thoroughly.
牙和牙床都要彻底刷干净。
Don't forget to brush your tongue.
Put only a little toothpaste on your toothbrush.
牙刷上只要挤一点点牙膏。
Mom, squeeze the toothpaste for me.
Has it been three minutes yet?
Brush my teeth for me, Mom.
Brush your teeth well, or they will turn black.
要好好刷牙，不然的话，你的牙齿会变黑。
If you don't take care of your teeth, you'll get cavities.
如果你不好好照顾你的牙齿，你会有蛀牙。
If you don't brush well, you'll have bad breath.
不好好刷牙的话，会有口臭。
Don't brush your teeth the wrong way.
不要用错误的方法刷牙。
Dad, come and eat with us.
爸爸，来和我们一起吃早餐。
Can you call your brother, too?
你可以也叫一下你弟弟吗？
Who wants to help me set the table?
Can you put the spoons on the table?
你可以把汤匙摆在餐桌上吗？
Let's say grace before we eat.
How is it? Isn't it good?
I don't feel like eating much.
I can't eat in the morning.
Just try and see if it's good.
先吃一口看看好不好吃。
You'll be late. Hurry up and eat.
Blow on your food to cool it off.
Is it okay if I don't finish it all?
Thank you for the nice meal.
谢谢你做这么好吃的一餐。
Don't be picky with your food.
Don't walk around while you eat.
吃饭的时候，不要走来走去。
Be careful not to drop your food.
It's okay. I'll clean it up.
Sit down and eat at the table.
Don't talk with your mouth full.
嘴巴内有东西时，不要说话。
Put your bowl in the sink.
Help me clean up the table.
Don't use too much toilet paper.
Tell me if you have to pee.
如果你要尿尿的话，要告诉我。
It's not good to hold your pee.
I don't want to sit on the toilet.
Wash your hands after you poop.
I keep farting. Hold your nose.
我一直要放屁。捏住你的鼻子。
Fart in my face, and I'll get you!
敢在我脸上放屁，看我怎么收拾你！
Did you pee in your pants?
It looks like you were in a rush.
Don't hold it until you pee in your pants next time.
下次，不可以忍到尿在裤子上。
爸爸，祝你有美好的一天。
Honey, want to polish Dad's shoes?
宝贝，要帮爸爸擦皮鞋吗？
Let me get your shoes ready, Dad.
Call us if you're going to be late.
会晚回来的话，打个电话回来。
Are you eating out with your coworkers?
I want to go with you, Dad!
Come home early to play with me.
Don't drink and come home early.
Bring me some goodies when you get back.
回来时，要买好吃的给我。
Dad is going to work now.
I'll miss you while I work.
当我在上班时，我会想你的。
Dad will call you at lunch hour.
午餐时，我会打电话给你。
Shall I bring you something good?
要我带什么好东西给你吗？
I'll come back from work as fast as I can.
下班后，我会尽可能早回家。
What do you want to wear?
Choose what you want to wear.
I want to wear a skirt today.
What do you need to wear today?
Today, you need to wear your school uniform.
今天，你需要穿学校制服。
Today, you need to wear your PE clothes.
Shorts are not good for this weather.
这个天气不适合穿短裤。
It's chilly, so you should wear a jacket.
天气很冷，你应该穿外套。
I don't want to wear those clothes.
I don't want to wear this shirt. Give me another one.
我讨厌穿这件衬衫，给我另一件。
I will wear this coat tomorrow, too.
明天，我也要穿这件外套。
When did you buy these pants?
这条裤子你什么时候买的？
这件夹克太女孩子气/男孩子气了。
I don't feel comfy in this shirt.
The pants don't match the shirt.
这条裤子跟那件衬衫不搭。
We need to wash this shirt. Get another one.
这件衬衫要洗了，拿其他的吧。
It's not fully dry yet. Wear it tomorrow.
那件还没干，等明天再穿。
That dress looks perfect on my princess.
那件连衣裙在我们公主身上太好看了。
Can you get dressed by yourself?
Do you want Mom to help you?
You put on your shirt inside out.
Let's change into some new underwear.
Can you help me put this on?
你可以帮我穿上这个吗？
你可以帮我解开衬衫的扣子吗？
你可以帮我拉开拉链吗？
These pants are too small now.
你长大了，这些衣服都不能穿了。
Wear what you want to wear.
Change into what you wear at home.
Isn't that too hot? Wear something else.
I'll just stay in these clothes.
Put your dirty clothes in the laundry basket.
把脏衣服放进洗衣篮里。
Put on the clothes that are ready.
Mom, where are the clothes ready to wear?
妈妈，我要穿的衣服在哪？
你还没穿衣服，在干什么呢？
现在你是大男孩/大女孩了。
I will tie your hair up nicely.
我会把你的头发绑得很漂亮。
Do you want it tied in a ponytail or pigtails?
你要绑马尾还是两条辫子？
Your hair has grown a lot.
You need a haircut at the hair salon.
你需要去理发店剪头发了。
Your hair is tangled up, so I can't comb it.
你的头发都打结了，我梳不开。
Want me to braid your hair?
Let me put your hair up.
我来把你的头发梳起来。
Can you hand me the hairpin?
My hair is poking me in the eyes.
Can you tie my hair like you did yesterday?
可以帮我绑得跟昨天一样吗？
Can you tie it again, please?
I want to wear my hair down today.
今天，我要把头发放下来。
Tie my hair in a ponytail.
请把我的头发绑成马尾。
请把我的头发绑成两条辫子。
Do you want to grow out your bangs?
What school supplies do you need today?
今天要带哪些学习用品？
Do you have your lunchbox and water bottle?
便当和水瓶都准备好了吗？
Do you have your indoor shoes?
I can't remember what I should bring.
I should bring some art supplies.
I need to get this paper signed.
What did your teacher ask you to bring?
Do you have art class today?
You should have your supplies prepared in advance.
你应该事先准备好学校用品。
Starting tomorrow, have it ready beforehand.
从明天开始，要事先准备。
确认一下东西都带齐了。
I forgot to pack your lunchbox.
Wow, you got it ready. Good job!
今天没有作业/不用带学习用品。
I don't know what to bring to school.
我不知道要带什么去学校。
My teacher never told us anything.
我们老师从不跟我们说任何事。
I thought I put them in your backpack.
我以为我已经把它们放进你书包了。
It's your job to get your supplies ready.
准备学校用品是你自己的事情。
You should stop by the stationery shop on your way to school.
你去学校时顺道去一下文具店吧。
You'll be late for school if you don't hurry.
如果你不快点的话，你上学就会迟到。
The day will be over soon.
You're going to miss the school bus.
Can you give me a ride?
Do you know how late you are?
你知道你晚了多久了吗？
I'm not waiting for you any longer.
If you keep on being late, it will become a hard habit to break.
如果你一直迟到的话，这个习惯会很难改掉。
I'll be outside waiting for you.
Finish before I count to three.
我们现在一定要出发了。
时间一分一秒地过去了。
Why does this have to happen every morning?
为什么每天早上都要这样？
Get your bag and put on your shoes.
Your shoes are on the wrong feet.
Don't step on the back of your shoes.
You need your sneakers if you want to run.
如果你要跑步的话，你需要穿运动鞋。
These shoes are old and torn.
I still love these shoes. Don't throw them away.
我还是很喜欢这双鞋子。不要丢掉。
Those shoes don't match your clothes.
那鞋子跟你的衣服不搭。
Put your shoes in the right place.
把鞋子放在该放的位置上。
Put your shoes on the shoe rack.
They must be on the shoe rack.
你已经长到鞋子穿不下了。
Let me buy you a new pair.
These new shoes hurt my feet.
I want to wear my dress shoes.
What shoes should I wear, Mom?
They are very dirty. They need to be washed.
它们都好脏喔，要洗一洗了。
要有礼貌地鞠躬打招呼，宝贝。
Shouldn't you say bye to Dad?
你不该跟爸爸说再见吗？
你是不是忘了什么？（亲亲）？
Call me after school. / Call me after you're done.
I'll see you later in the afternoon.
I'll be waiting with a tasty snack ready.
我会准备好吃的点心等你。
Will you be home when I come back?
穿越马路一定要走在斑马线上。
Be careful when you cross the street.
Look both ways while you are walking.
走路时，要注意左右两边。
Make sure you walk when the light is green.
确定是绿灯时，你才能走。
Raise your hand when you cross the street.
Don't play with your cell phone on the street.
不要在路上玩你的手机。
绝对不可以跟陌生人走。
Don't go down the narrow back street.
不可以走到狭窄的巷弄。
Ask your teacher if you want to go to the bathroom.
如果你要去厕所，你要跟老师说一声。
Turn off your cell phone at school.
Don't stop at the game machine. Just pass by it.
不要在游戏机前停留，走过去就好。
What should you do when there is a bully?
当有恶霸时你应该怎么做呢？
If you meet a bully, tell me at once.
如果你遇到有人欺负你，要立刻告诉我。
按住按钮让电梯等一下。
Can you press the first floor?
Don't lean on the elevator door.
Don't goof around in the elevator.
不要在电梯内跳来跳去。
Be careful! You might get stuck in the door.
What floor are you going to?
我们出去吧。（也经常使用 get off）。
Get off when the elevator is completely open.
当电梯门完全打开后，再出去。
Be careful when you get off.
Always look at what floor you're leaving.
出去之前，要看一下是几楼。
Let's have a race to the first floor.
我们比赛看谁先到一楼。
Don't ever run on the stairs.
绝对不可以在楼梯上跑。
Go down one step at a time.
Don't goof around on the steps. You might get hurt.
不可以在楼梯上捣蛋，你会受伤的。
It's about time for the bus.
Your school bus will be here very soon. Let's hurry!
I like riding on the school bus.
Go line up nicely for the bus.
We're early. No one's here yet.
我们来早了。一个人也没有耶。
There are a lot of kids already waiting in line.
已经有很多朋友在排队了。
Let's hurry up the next time.
Oh, the bus is already here.
I'll be the first in line.
There's the bus. / I see the bus coming.
Wait until the bus has stopped.
Okay, let's get on the bus now.
Get on the bus one after another. / Get on the bus one by one.
Be careful when you get on and off the bus.
Mommy will take you to school today.
今天妈妈会送你去学校。
Do you want to try using the vacuum?
Open the window and let the fresh air in.
打开窗户让新鲜空气进来。
Can you move a little bit?
Can you move your toys so I can vacuum?
你能移开你的玩具，让我用吸尘器吸一下吗？
You need to move the stuff on the floor.
你必须把地板上的东西移开。
I just want to get the dust off.
Isn't the vacuum heavy? Give it to Mommy.
吸尘器很重吧？拿给妈妈吧。
I want to clean up my room.
Want to take a little break?
It's so clean after we clean up.
We finished early because of you, my darling.
亲爱的，幸好有你帮忙，打扫提前结束了。
You're all grown up, helping Mommy clean the house.
你长大了，可以帮妈妈打扫房子了。
I'm going to sweep the floor today.
We're going to wipe the room with a rag.
We need to use the vacuum before we wipe the floor.
我们在擦地之前，要先用吸尘器吸过。
Can you help me clean the room?
Can you get me the rag?
Turn it over and clean the floor.
把抹布翻过来，然后清洁地板。
We need to wash the rag.
Clean everywhere and make everything nice and neat.
打扫每个地方，并让每个东西都干净整洁。
Wipe as hard as you can.
It looks like you're cleaning carelessly.
看起来你打扫得很漫不经心。
Mom, this isn't all clean yet.
妈妈，这里还没有擦干净。
I think Daddy should do it.
我想这个应该让爸爸做。
Clean quickly and get me the rag.
Wiping the floor is tiring, isn't it?
My knees hurt after kneeling down.
跪完之后，我的膝盖好痛喔。
The toys on the floor are a mess.
Why is it such a mess?
You should clean up after you play.
玩完之后，你应该收拾好。
What should you do with your toys when you finish playing with them?
玩完玩具后，你应该怎么做呢？
Go put away your toys so Mommy can clean up the room.
去整理你的玩具，妈妈要打扫房间。
I was just about to clean them up.
Can I play a bit longer?
I'll clean up after a little while.
I don't want to clean it up. Just leave it there, please.
我不想整理，就这样放着吧。拜托啦。
Can you clean up by yourself?
Pick up the blocks and the other toys.
You should put the books on the shelves.
你应该把书放在书架上。
Put it in the toy box.
Put it back where it was.
这些玩具应该放哪里呢？
You should put away your own toys.
你应该收拾自己的玩具。
Wow! You cleaned up so nicely.
You deserve a sticker for cleaning up.
你收拾好了，应该得到一张贴纸。
Mommy feels so happy because you're helping me.
The toys want to go back to their home.
这些玩具想回到它们的家。
Can I throw this away since it's still on the floor?
还在地板上的这个玩具，可以丢掉吗？
Ugh, when are we going to clean up all of this?
喔，我们什么时候把这些都收拾干净？
Should we give the toys away to other kids now?
那我们现在把这些玩具送给其他小朋友好吗？
Don't give them away. I'll clean them up.
不要把它们送走，我会收拾的。
The bookshelves are all messed up.
书架已经乱得不像样了。
I want to clean up my desk by myself.
Please clean up my room for me, Mom.
I'm sorry. I'll clean it up right away.
不好意思，我现在马上打扫。
It is so messy that I can't clean it by myself.
这太脏乱了，我一个人没办法打扫。
I won't mess it up the next time.
下次，我不会再弄得这样脏乱了。
There are a lot of dishes today.
Put the dishes in the sink.
Please put away the dishes you used.
请把你自己用过的碗收走。
Please put away the dishes from the table.
请把餐桌上的碗筷收走。
Can you help me do the dishes?
Who will do the dishes today?
I want to try doing the dishes.
Let me do the dishes from now on.
You're a big boy/girl now helping me do the dishes.
现在你能帮我洗碗，真的长大了。
You can do that when you are older.
等你再大一点后，再做吧。
Put on the rubber gloves and put the liquid soap on the sponge.
戴上橡胶手套，再把洗碗精挤在海绵上。
Wash the dishes carefully so they will not break.
要小心洗碗，不要把碗打破了。
Wash them carefully so there is no residue left.
仔细清洗，不要留下食物残渣。
There is still some soap on it. It's slippery.
上面还有些泡泡，很滑喔。
Oily residue is hard to get off.
Use hot water to wash off the grease.
Place the dripping bowls upside down on the rack.
请把湿的碗倒过来放在架子上。
Dry the plates with a dish towel.
用洗碗的毛巾把盘子擦干。
We've got a lot to clean, so let's use the dishwasher.
有很多碗要洗，那让我们用洗碗机吧。
Load the dishes in the dishwasher.
The detergent should go in here.
Okay, close the door and push this button.
好，把门关起来，然后按下按钮。
I'm going to use the washing machine.
I'm going to do the laundry.
Let's put the laundry in the machine.
把要洗的衣服放进洗衣机内。
Put the colored clothes here and the whites over there.
有颜色的衣服放这里，白色的衣服放那里。
Mom, can you wash this shirt?
妈妈，你能洗这件衬衫吗？
There are stains on the shirt.
We're going to boil the whites and towels.
我们来把白衣服和毛巾煮一煮消毒吧。
There is a lot of laundry to do.
Don't put those clothes in the machine.
不要把那些衣服放进洗衣机。
We have to dry-clean those clothes.
Let's hang the clothes on the rack.
我们把衣服晾在晾衣架上吧。
Will you help me hang the clothes?
你能帮我晾这些衣服吗？
Try hanging your clothes by yourself.
你的衣服你自己试着晾晾看。
I want to hang the socks.
Put it on the drying rack.
Shake each item and put it on the rack.
一件件抖开之后，再把它们晾上去。
Wow, Dad's trunks are super big!
Make sure the clothes don't hit the ground.
确认衣服不会掉到地板上。
Put the shirt on the hanger.
It will be all dry tomorrow.
The laundry's going to dry well because it's sunny.
因为天气好，衣服会很快干。
A sunny day is a good laundry day.
If it rains, the laundry won't dry well.
下雨的话，衣服不太会干。
The laundry's not completely dry yet.
We should get the dry clothes.
我们应该把干的衣服收一收。
Let's take the clothes off the rack.
我们把衣服从晾衣架上拿下来吧。
Can you help me get the clothes off?
Can you help me fold the clothes?
Fold it in half like this.
Put the socks in the sock bin.
Can you put the clothes back in their place?
你能把衣服放回原处吗？
You should fold your own clothes.
Let me fold mine by myself.
Can you find the other pair?
Put Daddy's clothes in one place.
把爸爸的衣服放在同一个地方。
Hang the shirts on the coat hanger.
This is how you fold clothes.
Mom, this is too big for me to fold.
妈妈，这件太大，我折不了。
Did I do a good job folding those clothes?
我折这些衣服折得好吗？
We need to iron Dad's shirt.
The iron looks like a boat.
这熨斗看起来像一条船。
The iron's too hot. It's dangerous.
Don't come near it since it's hot.
Go sit over there while I'm ironing.
我烫衣服的时候，你去那边坐着。
We need to spray it with water first.
Will you get me the spray bottle?
你能把喷水瓶拿给我吗？
We need to straighten out the wrinkles by ironing.
我们是为了弄平皱褶才烫衣服的。
The wrinkles are gone. That's cool!
Wait! You should wear your pants after we iron them.
等一下！等我们烫完裤子你再穿。
我们应该烫一下妈咪的围裙。
Pleated skirts are hard to iron.
We need to iron it so there are no wrinkles.
我们应该烫到没有皱褶。
We need to make the creases neat.
烫过后，衣服不是很整齐吗？
It's warm since we just ironed it.
Let me spray water on the shirt for you.

我们昨天读到哪里了呢？
Stop reading and go to bed now.
How about going to sleep now?
I'll read to you again tomorrow.
Can you read the rest tomorrow?
明天你可以讲剩下的吗？
Mommy's too tired today. Let's just stop reading for now.
妈妈今天太累了，现在不讲了。
Go to sleep in your room.
Now that you're grown up, go to sleep in your room.
既然你长大了，就去自己的房间睡吧。
Now that you're in elementary school, go to sleep in your room.
既然你已经读小学了，去自己的房间睡。
Mom, will you stay with me until I go to sleep?
妈，你可以陪我到我睡着吗？
Mom, I'm scared. I want to sleep with you.
妈，我好害怕哦。我要跟妈妈一起睡。
Mom, I want to sleep with you one last time today.
妈，今天让我最后一次跟你睡吧。
Want me to sing you to sleep?
Mom, don't turn off the light.
Mom, I can't go to sleep by myself.
妈，我没办法自己一个人睡。
Don't worry, Mommy will be with you.
不用担心，妈咪会跟你在一起。
This doll will be with you.
这个娃娃会跟你在一起。
I'll leave the door open so you can hear me.
我会把门开着，你就能听到我的声音了。
I'll check if you're asleep. Don't worry.
我会来看你睡了没，不用担心。
Mom, I'm all grown up now.
It's time to go to bed.
It's dark outside. It's time to go to sleep.
It's past 10 o'clock. Go to bed.
已经超过10点了，上床睡觉。
Go to the bathroom before you go to sleep.
I don't have to pee. I already went.
我不用尿尿，我已经去过了。
Mommy will kiss you. Good night!
Mom, wake me up early tomorrow.
You have to get right up when I wake you up.
当我叫醒你之后，你要立刻起床。
Mom, I can't sleep. I want to go to sleep later.
妈，我睡不着，我想晚点睡。
You need to go to sleep early to wake up early.
Don't go to bed too late.
I woke up because I needed some water.
I want to go to the bathroom.
I woke up because I wanted to pee.
I think you wet the bed.
Eek! You wet the bed, honey.
Get changed and go back to sleep.
I woke up in the dark, and I was scared.
我醒来时暗暗的，我好害怕。
Isn't it the morning right now?
I had a dream I was getting chased by a monster.
My sweetie must have been scared.
我的宝贝一定被吓坏了吧。
You're okay now. Mommy's right here.
现在没事了，妈妈就在这里。
My baby must have had a nightmare.
我的宝贝一定是做恶梦了。
That wasn't real. It was just a dream.
那不是真的，只是一个梦而已。
Sleep with your favorite bear in your arms.
抱着你最喜欢的熊宝宝睡吧。
You can go back to sleep now, right?
现在你可以再睡了，对吧？
I want to sleep next to you.
It will be all right if I hold you.
妈妈抱着你的话，就没事了。
Try to go back to sleep now.

secs.t: 美国小孩喜欢的节日-复活节
p: 我们来彩绘复活节彩蛋吧。
I've hidden the eggs somewhere. Let's start the Easter egg hunt now!
我已经把彩蛋藏在某些地方了。现在开始找彩蛋吧！
What will be in the basket?
There's the Easter Bunny over there. Let's say hello to the bunny.
那边有复活节兔子耶。来跟兔子打招呼吧。

secs.t: 美国小孩喜欢的节日-万圣节前夕
p: 我们一起来做南瓜灯吧。
Cut a circle around the stem and lift it off.
在南瓜蒂周围用刀划一圈，然后把盖子拿起来。
Scoop out the seeds and sticky insides with a big spoon.
用大汤匙把籽和黏稠的瓤都挖出来。
Draw the features on the pumpkin with a pen.
Cut out the face. Use the knife carefully.
Clear away the rough edges inside the pumpkin.
把南瓜内侧粗糙的边角整理一下。
Put a lit candle in and close the lid.
放入点亮的蜡烛后，盖上盖子。
南瓜灯看起来好可怕哦！
I love my Jenny the most.
Who do you love the most in the world?
你真是个了不起的宝贝。
How much do you love me, Mommy?
My love for you is as big as the universe.
我对你的爱像宇宙那么大。
You know how much I love you, right?
你知道我有多爱你，对吧？
Mommy loves you the most in the entire world.
在这个世界上，妈妈最爱你了。
Thanks so much for being my son/daughter.
谢谢你成为我的儿子/女儿。
I love you more than words can say.
我太爱你了，已经不能用言语来表达。
I can't live without you, darling.
达令，没有你，我活不下去。
How could I live without my loving son/daughter?
没有我心爱的儿子/女儿，我怎么活得下去呢？
I love you just the way you are.
I'm so happy because of you.
Who do you love more, me or Daddy?
你爱谁多一点，我还是爸爸？
Of course I love you more.
I love you both the same.
你看起来像个小王子/小公主。
You're so pretty. Whose pretty daughter is this?
你好漂亮，这是谁家的漂亮女儿呀？
Amazing! Your friends will be surprised to see you.
太让人惊讶了！你的朋友看到你，一定会很吃惊的。
I'm pretty because I look like you.
我很漂亮，因为我长得像你。
People say you and I look alike.
大家都说妈妈和我长得很像。
Your hard work paid off, right?
你的努力得到了好的结果，对吧？
Good job. Can you do this well next time, too?
很好，下次你也能做得这么好吗？
Wow, you're a good boy. Even Mommy should learn from you.
哇，你真是个好男孩，连妈妈都要向你学习了。
Mommy's happy to see you behave like that.
看到你表现这么好，妈妈好开心。
Don't you feel proud of yourself?
你也为自己感到自豪吧？
Did you think I wouldn't do well?
Did you think I wouldn't make it?
This was better than I had expected.
I guess your efforts were rewarded.
我猜你的努力得到回报了。
I'm going to try harder next time.
How did you get the idea?
I'm so proud you did it all by yourself.
你独自完成了这件事，我真为你骄傲。
It should be an example for others.
这可以成为别人的榜样。
I knew you could do it.
Aren't you happy? Mommy feels happy, too.
你很开心吧？妈妈也很开心。
Let's call Daddy and tell him the good news.
我们打电话给爸爸，告诉他这个好消息吧！
What should Mommy give you as a gift?
妈妈该送你什么礼物呢？
Come here. I'll give you a hug.
Let's give a round of applause!
I'll treat you to a wonderful dinner as a reward.
妈妈请你吃一顿大餐当作奖励！
Let's have a party to celebrate this.
我们开个派对为此庆祝一下。
Your aunt wants to congratulate you.
So what you're saying is this, right?
所以这就是你要说的，对吗？
You're right. Of course you would feel that way.
Do you agree with me, Mommy?
From your point of view, that could be.
站在你的立场，那是有可能的。
That has happened to me, too.
那种事情也曾发生在我身上。
我以前也有过那种感觉。
Mom, I think I'm a scaredy-cat.
妈妈，我想我是个胆小鬼。
Want me to hold your hand?
You don't have to be scared.
It's okay if you make a mistake. Try your best.
做错也没关系，尽你的全力吧。
Mommy was just like you when I was your age.
妈妈在你的年纪时也是这样。
Make up your own mind. It's up to you.
自己拿主意吧，由你决定。
I didn't make it again. / I messed up again.
我又没成功。/我又搞砸了。
You don't have to be so down.
You can do it. I trust in you.
Go for it! I'm always on your side.
去做吧！我永远站在你这一边。
I feel bad I couldn't win the award.
I am such a fool to have made the same mistake again.
我真傻，又犯了同样的错误。
It will be better next time.
I'm not going to try that again.
It's a shame I could not make it through.
真遗憾，我没能坚持到底。
我会让你打起精神来的。
你现在觉得好一点了吗？
If you eat something, you'll feel better.
吃点东西，你会感觉好一点的。
What can make you feel better?
怎样做才能让你心情变好呢？
It could've been worse. Just wait and see.
本来可能会更糟的。等着看吧。
Did something happen with your friend?
你跟朋友发生什么事了吗？
I'm never going to talk to him again.
我再也不要和他说话了。
I don't want to play with him anymore.
朋友之间是不可以打架的。
Friends shouldn't curse at each other.
朋友之间不可以互相骂人。
If you keep fighting, I won't let you hang out together.
如果你们还吵架，我就不让你们一起玩了。
Your friend is probably regretting it, too.
你的朋友可能也后悔了。
But you shouldn't hate your friend.
但是你不可以讨厌你的朋友。
How about talking to your friend about your feelings?
跟你的朋友说说你的感受，怎么样？
Why don't you try talking to him first?
为什么你不试着先跟他说话呢？
站在他/她的立场想一想。
It doesn't matter who started it.
If you guys argue, Mommy feels hurt.
你们吵架的话，妈妈会很心痛的。
你不可以打自己的妹妹。
I told you that you should not hit your sister.
我不是告诉过你不可以打你妹妹吗？
You should be nice to your sister.
你应该好好对待你的妹妹。
You should look after your sister.
You are older, so let your brother have it.
你比较大，你应该让着弟弟。
Don't be rude to your brother and talk like that.
不可以对你的哥哥那样没礼貌地说话。
You'll get a timeout if you spit again.
如果你再吐口水，就要罚你去面壁思过。
You both want to get punished?
You both are grounded now. You can't watch TV.
现在你们两个都要受罚。不可以看电视。
Won't you stop right this minute?
你们能不能马上停下来？
Are you going to do it again?
Does it seem right to argue with your older sister?
跟你姐姐吵架是对的吗？
不可以用命令的，要用请求的。
You are a big brother. Please act mature.
你是哥哥，要有哥哥的样子。
You are not acting responsibly as a big sister.
你作为姐姐，怎么这么没有责任感。
Didn't you promise you wouldn't fight?
你们不是说好再也不吵架了吗？
You know you might get a timeout, huh?
你知道你可能会被罚，对吧？
兄弟/姐妹间应该友好相处。
Can you buy me this? Please!
你能买这个给我吗？拜托啦！
It's too much for an elementary school student.
这个对小学生来说太贵了。
为什么你的要求这么多？
You have the same thing at home.
I know you want it, but not now.
我知道你想要，但是现在不行。
Mom, you always say next time.
Mommy, you buy everything you want.
妈咪，你自己想要的都买了。
You always buy things for my brother but not for me.
你总是买东西给弟弟，却没有给我买。
Only this time. This is the last time.
就这一次，这是最后一次。
Mommy doesn't get everything she wants either.
妈妈也不是想要什么都买。
Why don't you buy it with your allowance?
你为什么不用你的零用钱买呢？
这不是给小孩子的东西。
This food isn't good for you.
We didn't come here for this today.
我们今天不是为了这个才来的。
Let's think if it's actually that necessary.
我们想想是不是真的需要。
Well, we don't have enough money for that right now.
可是，我们现在没有足够的钱可以买。
People are staring at us. Stop!
大家都在看我们了，别闹了！
Stop looking at it. Let's leave now.
The amount will be taken out of your allowance after I buy you this. Okay?
如果我买这个给你，钱要从你的零用钱里扣，可以吗？
You can get this when you collect 30 "good job" stickers.
等你集满30张奖励贴纸，就可以买这个。
Why do you care? It's not your business.
你干嘛管那个？那不关你的事。
我看你是不知道自己在干什么吧。
你为什么这么不专心呢？
宝贝，我们刚才在做什么呢？
Don't move around. Sit here and listen.
不要跑来跑去。坐下来听我说。
How many times should I tell you?
Stay on that for at least 10 minutes.
Do you know what you're doing?
Is this what you should be doing?
这是你现在要做的事情吗？
Do you not want to do this? Do you want to do it next time?
你不想做这个吗？你要下次再做吗？
I know I have to, but it's not working out.
我知道我得去做，但就是做不好。
I can't stop thinking about other things.
Can I do it after I finish this comic book?
我可以看完这本漫画书后再去做吗？
It's too difficult to stay focused.
集中注意力真是太难了。
One hour is too long for me.
对我来说，一小时太长了。
我想知道你为什么说谎？
I won't scold you, so tell me the truth.
我不责备你，告诉我实话。
我是一时不小心说了谎。
I lied because I was afraid I would get in trouble.
我害怕被你责骂，所以才说了谎。
Are you going to lie again?
Mommy trusts you. You won't do it again, right?
妈妈相信你，你不会再这样了，对吧？
A small lie becomes a big lie.
一个小谎言会变成大谎言的。
因为你说谎，妈妈很不开心。
You don't want to be a liar, do you?
你也不想成为一个说谎的人，对吧？
It's brave to tell the truth.
说实话也是很有勇气的。
I hope you won't ever lie to me.
我希望你不会再对我说谎。
It was wrong to do that.
You could be lying without knowing it.
你可能在不知不觉中说了谎。
If you tell a lie, don't you feel ashamed of yourself?
说谎的话，你都不会觉得羞愧吗？
I can tell you are lying.
I really hate when people lie to me.
当有人对我撒谎时我很讨厌。
Lying is the worst thing in the world.
在这个世界上，说谎是最坏的。
Nobody wants to be with a liar.
没有人会想跟说谎的人在一起。
Why do you do this all the time?
I've told you to hurry up a thousand times.
我已经跟你说了一千次要快点了。
I'm sick of it! / I'm tired of it!
Gosh, you're as slow as a snail.
It's okay. I can make it on time.
Can you make it on time?
That's too much. You should stop.
太过分了，你该停下来了。
Be quiet and listen to me.
Can't you quiet down a bit?
Could you be quiet since I'm on the phone?
我在讲电话，你能安静一点吗？
I can't hear the other person.
我都听不到对方的声音了。
Can you play quietly because Mommy's sick?
妈妈很不舒服，你能安静点玩吗？
How many times do I have to tell you to be quiet?
我要说多少次你才会安静？
你应该管好自己的嘴巴。
Do you think you should talk like that?
你觉得你一定要那样说吗？
Why shouldn't I tell you what I want?
为什么我不能跟你说我想说的？
Where did you learn that attitude?
你从哪里学来这种态度的？
I'm not going to hold back if you say one more word.
你要是再多说一句，我就不客气了。
How could you do such a thing?
你怎么可以做那样的事呢？
You should know better than that.
What's the right way to do it?
Did your teacher teach you like that?
你的老师是那样教的吗？
Did Mommy teach you that way?
I don't want you to grow up like that.
我可不想你长大后变成那样。
Do you know what you did wrong?
你知道你哪里做错了吗？
You don't want to be a rude child, right?
你也不想成为一个没礼貌的小孩，对吧？
Don't use that word in front of adults.
在大人面前不可以说那样的话。
Would you be happy if you were him/her?
如果你是他/她的话，你会开心吗？
Stop it. It's really bugging me.
I don't want to hear you whine.
I told you not to get upset so easily.
我跟你说过不要那么容易生气。
Why are you getting angry at Mommy?
为什么你生妈妈的气呢？
I'm going to listen if you speak properly.
你好好说的话，我会听的。
Tell me if there's something wrong.
有什么不对的就告诉我。
I'm just annoyed. / I just don't feel well.
我就是不开心。/我就是不舒服。
I don't know why I feel annoyed.
我也不知道为什么不开心。
When you're angry, you look ugly.
If you feel bad, nothing goes right.
如果你心情不好，什么事都不会顺利。
That's nothing to feel bad about.
Tell me what you did wrong.
Timeout! Sit in the Thinking Chair.
罚你暂停！坐到反省椅上。
You know what you did wrong, right?
你知道你做错了什么，对吧？
Mommy doesn't want to punish you.
But you should be responsible for your actions.
但是你应该对你的行为负责。
I won't ever do it again.
You can't watch TV because of your wrongdoing.
因为你犯错了，所以你不能看电视。
You're grounded and can't use the computer because of what you did today.
因为你今天做的事情，罚你不能用电脑。
It's all for your own good.
Look at each other in the eyes and say sorry.
看着对方的眼睛说对不起。
Let's make sure this never happens again. All right?
我们一定不要再发生这种事，好吗？
I didn't do it on purpose.
I didn't mean it that way.
It was a mistake. I'm really sorry.
这是个失误，真的很对不起。
You owe me a big apology.
你欠我一个郑重的道歉。
Think for yourself. It was your fault.
你自己想想，那是你的错。
Did you hate me because I scolded you?
因为我责备你，所以你讨厌我了吗？
Why did you let out a huge sigh?
你为什么叹那么大一口气？
I want you to grow up to be a wonderful person.
我希望你长大后能成为很棒的人。
Come here. I'll give you a kiss.
You know how Mommy feels, right?
你知道妈妈的心情，对吧？
Want to go for a walk?
I was scared when you were mad, Mommy.
妈咪，当你生气时我好害怕哦。
I didn't do it because I hated you.
我不是因为讨厌你才那样做。
Mommy was too mean. I'm sorry.
But you are still my beloved baby.
但你还是我心爱的宝贝。
That's not the right thing to do.
Is that what you should be doing?
Do what you are supposed to do.
That's what I'm not pleased with.
This is not what should happen.
Why do you always think I'm wrong?
为什么你总是认为我做错了？
I hope you won't do it.
Tell me what you did wrong.
Why do you keep doing that?
为什么你还继续那样做？
Do you think you did the right thing?
Don't lose your temper so quickly. That's not good.
不要动不动就发脾气，那样不好。
Don't take out your anger on others.
不要把脾气发在别人身上。
That's a bad word. Don't say that!
那是不好的话，不可以那样说！
If you can't control yourself, I'm going to punish you.
如果你不能管好自己的话，我就会处罚你。
The one who controls his anger wins.
谁能忍住脾气，谁就是赢家。
You need to get your anger under control.
你需要控制好你的脾气。
Why are you taking out your anger?
I'm just so mad I don't know what to do.
我太生气了，不知道该怎么办。
I don't want to talk to you.
Then I'm going to get mad at you, too.
那么，我也要对你发脾气了。
Don't run. You could trip and fall.
There are a lot of cars.
It's dangerous. There's a car coming.
Look around to see if there are any cars.
要看看四周有没有车子来。
Walk on the inner side of the sidewalk.
Be careful! There's someone in your way.
Don't run where there are a lot of people.
不要在人很多的地方跑来跑去。
等一下，这里写着要停下来。
You fell down doing that the last time.
你上次也是那样才跌倒的。
How come you ran ahead of us?
你怎么跑到我们前面去了？
I was shocked because I thought I had lost you.
我以为跟你走丢了，吓了一跳。
I almost fell down like you warned me.
就像你提醒我的一样，我差点跌倒了。
Oh, gosh! That was a close call.
Your brother's running because you are running.
因为你在跑，你弟弟也跟着跑了。
Don't jump on the couch. There is dust everywhere.
不可以在沙发上跳，到处都是灰尘。
The building manager is going to come up.
You should never run at night.
The people downstairs are going to say it's loud.
Would you like it if you heard stomping from the upstairs neighbors?
你会喜欢听到楼上邻居咚咚跺脚的声音吗？
What happens if I touch this?
如果我碰到这个，会怎么样呢？
If you touch it, you'll get in trouble.
碰到的话，你会有麻烦的哦。
I don't want you to touch it.
Don't touch it because it's very dangerous.
Don't let your brother touch it.
Not yet. You can touch it when you grow up.
还不行，等你长大后才可以碰。
Let me put this out of your reach.
我把这个放到你拿不到的地方。
If you get hurt, Mommy will be sad.
如果你受伤，妈妈会难过的。
Let's promise never to touch it.

secs.t: 不要碰哥哥妹妹的东西
p: Don't touch it because it's your brother's.
这是你哥哥的东西，不要碰喔。
Your sister is not going to like it if you touch it.
如果你碰了这个东西，你妹妹会不高兴的。
Your sister really cares about it.
你妹妹真的很珍惜那个东西。
I just want to look at it.
I'll put it back right after I look at it.
我看完后会把它放回原位。
Do you like it when someone touches your stuff?
你会喜欢有人碰你的东西吗？
Did your sister allow you to touch it?
Ask first and then play with it.
I won't help you when your sister gets mad.
如果你妹妹生气的话，我不会帮你的。
Handle it carefully and then put it back.
小心地拿，然后放回原位。
Mom, can you keep it a secret?
Please don't tell her I played with this.
请不要告诉妹妹我玩了这个。
Your sister will get mad for sure.

你要不要和我一起玩角色扮演？
Write in your reading log since you're done reading it.
既然你读完了，就写在阅读记录表上吧。
到目前为止，我读了200本书。
Mom, it's time to watch a DVD!
Mom, can I watch a DVD?
What DVD do you want to watch today?
Want to watch the new one that we recently bought?
你要看最近我们新买的那片吗？
Why don't you pick one by yourself?
I want to watch the Magic School Bus.
Do you want me to choose it for you?
You have watched it too many times.
那个你已经看过很多次了。
Why don't you try to choose another one?
Can I see two DVDs today?
Well, you know that watching too much TV is not good for you.
嗯，你知道看太多电视对你不好。
I want to watch the one that I saw yesterday.
我想看我昨天看的那一片。
It's my turn to choose the DVD because Minsu picked his favorite yesterday.
因为昨天民秀选了他喜欢的，这次轮到我选DVD了。
We'll watch the DVD for 30 minutes only. Okay?
我们只看30分钟的DVD，知道吗？
I like the Disney animated films the most.
我最喜欢迪士尼的动画片了。
Can I watch it with the subtitles on?
Let's watch it without any subtitles.
You can watch it this time only.
Mom, how do I play the DVD?
I will show you how, so watch carefully.
我示范给你看，仔细看好。
Let's try to control it with the remote control.
我们试着用遥控器来操作。
Place the DVD into the player.
Hold it by putting your index finger into the center hole.
把食指伸进中间的洞来拿着。
If DVDs get scratched, they can be ruined.
如果DVD被刮伤，就可能会坏掉。
Mom, I want to play the DVD by myself.
Okay, sure. Give it a try!
Close the tray and push the play button.
关上光碟盘后，按下播放键。
Change the TV to "external input" mode.
把电视切换到“外部输入”模式。
Mom, it does not work. / It's not working.
I saw this part already. Please skip the movie to the next part.
我已经看过这部分了，请跳到下一部分。
It's too loud. Please turn it down.
声音太大了，请调小声一点。
Don't you think the sound is already too loud?
你不觉得声音已经太大了吗？
I think this will be just right.
Can you please turn the volume up a little?
你能把音量调大一点吗？
Do you want me to turn up the volume a little bit?
你要我把音量调大一点吗？
If you listen to it that loud, your ears will get hurt.
如果你听得那么大声，你的耳朵会受伤的。
When the disc stops spinning, we'll take it out.
当光碟停止转动，我们就把它拿出来。
When you are finished, be sure to turn the TV and audio off.
当你看完时，一定要把电视和音响关掉。
Put the DVD back into the case carefully.
The title of the book is Thank You, Mr. Falker.
这本书的书名是《Thank You, Mr. Falker》。
The author of the book is Patricia Polacco.
The main character of the story is Trisha.
The main characters are Trisha and Mr. Falker.
The setting of the story is the 1950s.
I like the story because Mr. Falker is a great teacher.
我喜欢这个故事，因为Falker先生是很优秀的老师。
My favorite part is when Trisha learns how to read with Mr. Falker.
我最喜欢的部分是Trisha跟Falker先生学习怎样阅读。
I will write a journal in English.
玩捉人游戏真的很有趣。
Today is such a fantastic day!
I hope every day will be like today.
我希望每天都可以像今天这样。
I am so happy my mom bought me new pants.
我妈买了新的裤子给我，我好开心。
I was so happy that I jumped up and down.
I'm very happy because I got a perfect score on my test.
因为我考试考了满分，所以我很开心。
It was my first time to ride on a train, and it was amazing.
这是我第一次搭火车，感觉太棒了。
我对所有事情都感到很烦。
The toy that I like the most is broken.
I am worried that I might not be able to get it fixed.
我担心我可能无法把它修好。
A big kid hit me in the back at school.
在学校有个大孩子打了我的背。
I had to force myself not to cry. / I tried very hard not to cry.
我必须强忍着不哭。/我努力忍住不哭。
I feel sorry for my brother because I got mad at him.
我对我弟弟感到很抱歉，因为我对他发脾气了。
I am very depressed because I got scolded by Mom.
我非常郁闷，因为我被妈妈骂了。
I was very sad because my friend moved away.
因为我朋友搬家了，所以我很伤心。
I feel bad and sad about not winning the prize.
我对于没有得奖感到又伤心又难受。
I wanted to hit my sister so much.
I could not go out today because of the rain.
因为下雨，我今天不能出门。
So many bad things kept happening today.
今天一直发生很多坏事。
My heart was aching so much because my fish died.
我的心很痛，因为我的鱼死了。
I have some really good news for you.
我有个好消息要告诉你。
You will have a baby brother or sister soon.
你很快就会有个弟弟或妹妹了。
You're going to be a big sister.
The baby will look exactly like you.
Wow, am I going to be a big sister now?
哇！我现在要当姐姐了吗？
Now I have a baby brother!
Now I have a baby sister!
I have always envied my friends who have younger brothers/sisters.
我一直很羡慕有弟弟/妹妹的朋友。
Are you going to play well with your baby brother or sister?
你会跟弟弟或妹妹好好玩吧？
I will be nice to the baby.
I will share my toys with my brother or sister.
我会把我的玩具分给弟弟或妹妹玩。
Let's call Grandma and tell her the good news!
我们给奶奶打电话，告诉她这个好消息吧。
We haven't decided yet. Let's just call it Rabbit for now.
我们还没有决定。现在我们先叫它“兔兔”吧。
The baby's pre-birth name is Button.
Do you want a baby sister or brother?
I want a pretty baby sister.
What do you like for your baby brother's name?
你想要你的弟弟叫什么名字？
I think Wonsu will be a good name.
我觉得元秀是个好名字。
I want to call him Wonsu.
Make sure you don't only love the baby. Okay?
你不可以只疼小宝宝喔，好吗？
Both of you are our children, so I will love both of you equally.
你们两个都是我的孩子，所以我会一样爱你们两个。
Of course! Mom loves Songjin the most. The baby is next.
当然！妈妈最爱松镇了，然后才是小宝宝。
Is there a baby inside Mommy's tummy?
妈咪的肚子里面有个小宝宝吗？
The baby will be growing in my tummy for the next ten months.
接下来十个月，小宝宝会在妈妈的肚子里长大。
So I need help from you from now on.
所以，从现在起我需要你的帮忙。
Don't worry, Mom. I will help you out with all the hard work.
妈咪，不用担心，辛苦的事我都会帮你做。
I have to see my doctor for a regular checkup today.
我今天要去看医生做定期检查。
小宝宝什么时候会出生？
How many days are left till the due date?
Why isn't the baby coming out yet?
为什么小宝宝还没出来？
You have to wait a long time.
It seems like he/she is not ready to see the world.
看起来，他/她还没准备好来到这个世界。
The baby will be born in a month.
小宝宝会在一个月后出生。
Fifteen days are left till the baby's due date.
In a week or so, the baby will come out.
大约再过一周，小宝宝就要出来了。
It's almost time for the baby to come.
小宝宝出生的时间快到了。
In a few days, you will meet your baby brother.
再过几天，你就会看到你的弟弟了。
Tomorrow is the due date for the baby.
明天就是宝宝的预产期了。
Well, the due date has passed, but the baby is still not coming out.
哎呀，预产期已经过了，但是小宝宝还是没有出来。
I can't wait to see my baby brother.
我等不及跟我的弟弟见面了。

secs.t: 对肚子内的小宝宝说话
p: Hi, baby. This is your Mommy.
Sweetie, do you hear Mommy's voice?
甜心，你听到妈妈的声音了吗？
Mommy and Daddy are so happy to have you.
妈咪和爸比都很开心有了你。
Whenever I think of you, I feel so happy.
每当我想起你，我都觉得好幸福。
You are Mommy and Daddy's gift and joy.
你是妈妈和爸爸的礼物和喜悦。
Mommy and Daddy can't wait to see you.
妈咪和爸比都很想快点儿见到你。
Can't you wait to see Mommy and Daddy, too?
你也等不及想见妈咪和爸比了吧？
Mommy is going to sing you a song.
This is Mommy's favorite song. Listen to it.
这是妈妈最喜欢的歌，好好听。
Mommy will read you a story.
Mommy will tell you a story.
Oh, sweetie, you're kicking now! Wow, look at how strong you are.
喔，甜心，你现在在踢呢！哇，看看你多强壮啊！
Mommy is eating delicious strawberries for you. Aren't they delicious?
妈妈为了你在吃好吃的草莓。很好吃吧？
Mommy is listening to some beautiful songs now. Can you hear them?
妈妈正在听好听的歌，你能听到吗？
My dear baby brother, I can't wait to see you, too.
亲爱的弟弟，我也迫不及待地想见你。
When we meet, let's play soccer and some games together.
当我们见面后，我们一起踢足球和玩游戏吧。
I will take good care of you, I promise.
我会好好照顾你的，我发誓。
When you come out, I will play with you every day.
你出生后，我会每天陪你玩。
Don't give Mommy a hard time, okay?
不要让妈妈太辛苦，好吗？
Be nice to Mommy, dear brother!
要好好地对妈咪，亲爱的弟弟！
I look forward to seeing you very much!
I'm going to have our baby today. / I'm going to give birth today.
今天，我要去生小宝宝了。
Hi, my baby. I'm your Mommy.
你好，我的宝宝。我是妈妈。
Did you have a hard time coming to see the world?
你来到这个世界，辛苦了吧？
You really, really did a good job.
Mommy is very proud of you, sweetie.
甜心，妈妈非常以你为荣。
You look so much prettier than Mommy imagined.
你比妈妈想象得漂亮多了。
You have no idea how much we were waiting to see you.
你不知道我们等了多久才见到你。
Mommy and Daddy are so happy that you are a healthy baby.
妈咪和爸比很高兴你是个健康的宝宝。
I really wanted to see you, my baby brother.
我的弟弟，我真的很想见到你。
The babies are fraternal twins. / The twins look different from each other.
Their eyes, nose, and lips all look the same.
他们的眼睛，鼻子，嘴巴都看起来一模一样。
Both of them are so adorable!
Who do you think the younger one is?
The baby who was born first is the older brother/sister.
先出生的宝宝是哥哥/姐姐。
We will need two of everything.
每一样东西，我们都需要两份。
Mommy will have twice as hard a time taking care of the twins.
妈咪要照顾双胞胎，会加倍地辛苦。
It will be really nice if Jina can help Mommy.
如果吉娜能帮助妈妈，那就真的太好了。
One of my friends is a twin, too.
我的一个朋友也是双胞胎。
Let's celebrate the birth of the twins!
我们来庆祝双胞胎的出生吧！

name: 孩子，有你真好！（0-12 个月）

p: Are you hungry? Do you want some milk, sweetie?
你饿了吗？甜心，你喝牛奶吗？
Okay, okay. Mommy will feed you very soon.
Mommy will mix a bottle. Just wait for a second, okay?
妈妈这就泡奶。稍等一下，好吗？
It looks like you prefer the breast to the bottle.
看起来，比起用奶瓶喂，你更喜欢妈妈亲喂。
Were you hungry? Drink the milk and grow well.
你饿了吗？喝奶快快长大喔。
Oh, that hurts. Don't bite Mommy!
Is it too hard to suck Mom's breast?
Okay. We'll take a break for a second.
Look at you! You are eating very well.
Why don't you have a little bit more?
为什么你不再多吃一点呢？
Oh, you want to stop? Are you full now?
喔，你不吃了吗？你饱了吗？
Is too much milk coming out? You are coughing!
奶水出来太多了吗？你呛到了！
The milk won't come out well? Sorry. I'm not making enough milk.
奶水出得不顺吗？抱歉，妈妈的奶水不太够。
See how Mommy nurses our baby.
You were just like this a few years ago.
Okay, baby, now you need to burp.
好，宝宝，现在你需要打嗝。
Mommy will gently pat your back.
Okay, baby, it's time to change your diaper.
好，宝贝，我们该换尿布了。
Let's see. Hmm.. Is it wet?
Oh, the diaper is still okay.
Oh, you even made some poo-poo. It stinks!
Your poop looks too watery. Does your tummy hurt?
你的便便看起来水水的。你肚子不舒服吗？
妈咪不知道你尿尿/便便了。
Eeek! Let me take off the dirty diaper.
啊！让我把脏的尿布拿掉。
Let's clean your bottom with baby wipes. Wishy-washy!
我们用湿纸巾擦擦屁屁。擦擦擦！
We also have to put some powder on.
So, how do you feel now, sweetie? Feel dry and fresh?
好，甜心，现在你感觉如何？有没有感觉很干净清爽？
Okay, now lift your pretty bottom up.
好，现在把你漂亮的屁屁抬起来。
You want Mommy to massage your legs, honey?
宝贝，你要妈咪帮你按摩腿吗？
Stretch, stretch! Mommy will give you a massage.
Okay, now bend your knees. Then stretch them up!
好，现在弯下膝盖。然后，把脚伸开。
Now let's put your pretty legs up toward the sky!
现在，我们把你漂亮的双腿往天空抬起。
Now, let's put on a new diaper.
现在，我们来穿新的尿布。
Yay! Your diaper has been changed. Feel great?
耶！尿布换好了。感觉很棒吧？
Hey, sweetie, it's time for a bath.
Now, let's take off your clothes and your diaper, too.
现在，我们把衣服和尿布都脱了。
Doesn't the water feel nice and warm? Or is it not warm enough?
水是不是很舒服、很温暖呢？还是不够热？
Let's play with the toy duck. Quack, quack!
我们跟鸭子玩具一起玩吧。呱呱！
Why don't you paddle your feet? Splash! Splash!
你用脚踢踢水好吗？啪啪！啪啪！
Mommy will make some bubbles with the shampoo.
妈妈用洗发精搓出泡泡。
Let's wash it with some clean water.
我们用干净的水冲一冲。
This slippery thing is called soap.
这个滑滑的东西叫做肥皂。
Now, let's wash your face and rub your body.
现在，我们来洗脸和身体。
Mommy will rinse it off quickly.
Okay, now let's wash off all the soap.
好，现在我们来把肥皂洗掉。
It's all done. Let me dry you off with a towel.
都洗好了。我来用毛巾把你擦干。
You are even prettier/more handsome after a bath.
洗完澡后，你变得更漂亮/更帅了。
Now that we have taken a bath, how do you feel?
现在我们洗完澡了，你觉得如何？
Do you want me to hold you?
Do you want me to give you a piggy-back ride?
Come here, sweetie. Let me give you a piggy-back ride.
Mommy will bring the baby carrier.
Mommy will hold you with the baby carrier.
How is it? Are you comfortable?
Is there anything that's bothering you?
有什么东西让你不舒服吗？
Sweetie, do you like riding on Mommy's back?
甜心，你喜欢让妈妈背吗？
Why don't you sleep on Mommy's back?
在妈妈的背上睡觉，好吗？
你能听到妈妈的心跳吗？
Do you want to come down now?
Why don't you get down? Mommy's arms hurt.
你何不下来呢？妈妈的手臂疼了。
Want to stay on Mommy's back for a little longer?
你要在妈妈的背上多呆一会吗？
Okay, let me put you down now.
婴儿背带（可以把婴儿固定在胸前或背后）
婴儿汽车安全座椅（有的有提把，可以提着走）
Why are you crying? Are you sleepy?
你为什么哭，你想睡了吗？
Are you tired? I think it's time to sleep.
你累了吗？我想你该睡觉了。
Come here. Mommy will put you to sleep.
Do you want to lie beside Mom and sleep together?
你想躺在妈妈旁边一起睡吗？
Want to ride piggy-back while you try to sleep?
Do you want to ride in the stroller as you try to sleep?
你想坐在婴儿推车上睡吗？
Sleep tight for a while, sweetie.
Do you want me to sing you a lullaby?
Go to dreamland as you listen to Mommy's lullaby.
边听妈妈的摇篮曲，边进入梦乡吧。
A good girl/boy never gets fussy before sleeping.
乖孩子睡觉前不闹脾气哦。
You have to sleep so that you can grow.
你一定要睡觉，才能长大。
Sweetie, close your eyes now and sleep tight.
甜心，现在闭上你的眼睛，好好睡吧。
The more you sleep, the more you grow.
你睡得越多，就长得越快。
You can meet Mommy in your dreams, sweetie.
甜心，你会在梦里见到妈妈。
Wow, you sleep like an angel.
哇，你睡的样子像个天使。
You've been cooing all day long.
你一整天都在咿咿呀呀。
You keep gurgling. Are you feeling good?
你一直咯咯地笑。你心情很好吗？
Oh, sweet baby, do you want to talk?
喔，小甜心，你想要说话吗？
You will be able to talk soon.
Look at Mommy and keep talking.
What are you saying? / What do you mean?
你在说什么？/那是什么意思？
Here we have a chatty baby.
我们家有个爱说话的宝宝。
哎呀，现在别再咿咿呀呀了。
甜心，别咿咿呀呀了，吃东西吧。
Yay! It seems like you're feeling great.
耶！你看起来心情很好喔。
Arms waving. Legs kicking. Are you that happy?
手摇脚晃。你那么开心吗？
You look so excited. I'm excited to see you.
你看起来很兴奋。我看着也跟着兴奋起来。
Why do you keep on crying? What's bothering you?
你为什么一直在哭？什么在烦你呢？
Are you sick? Let me check if you have a fever.
你生病了吗？我看看你有没有发烧？
Are you sleepy? Do you want to take a nap?
你困了吗？你想睡个午觉吗？
Are you hungry? Is that why you are crying?
你饿了吗？所以你才哭吗？
Do you want me to give you a bottle?
If you keep on crying, a scary monster will come and get you.
如果你还一直哭的话，可怕的怪物就会来把你抓走。
You don't want to lie on your back?
Do you want to roll over?
Are you going to turn over and move around?
你想要翻身移动一下吗？
Look at you! You are trying to turn yourself over.
看看你！你正努力翻身呢！
Okay, you are almost there. Try a little bit harder.
好，你几乎快做到了。再努力一点点。
Wow, you finally turned over by yourself!
哇，你终于靠自己翻身了。
It was pretty tough, wasn't it, sweetie?
Oh, no! Don't turn over while I am changing your diaper.
喔，不行！我在帮你换尿布时，不可以翻身。
Do you want to sit up?
Oh, you might fall down. Be careful!
Now straighten your back and hold it strongly.
现在，挺直你的背，用力撑住。
Are you tired now? Do you want to lie down again?
你现在累了吗？你想要再躺下来吗？
Will you sit in the baby walker?
Oh my! You can push yourself up on your tummy.
喔，天呀！你能趴着把自己撑起来了。
Now you have learned how to crawl!
Want to crawl to the front/back?
Put a little more effort into it. There you go.
You are using your knees to crawl.
You are crawling with your knees up.
Okay, put more effort into it. Crawl to Mommy.
好，再努力一点。爬向妈咪。
You're crawling all over the house.
Oh, no! This crawling baby touches everything.
喔，不！这个会爬的小家伙什么都要摸。
Let me look in your mouth.
让我看看你的嘴巴里面。
Don't your gums feel itchy? / Your gums must be itching.
你的牙床不会痒痒的吗？/你的牙床一定很痒。
It seems like your baby teeth will come out.
看起来你的乳牙要长出来了。
Congratulations! You're about to get your first teeth.
恭喜！你的第一颗牙齿要长出来了。
Finally, your baby teeth are coming out!
终于，你的乳牙长出来了。
Hey, baby, you have teeth now!
嘿，宝贝，你现在有牙齿了！
I see two front teeth on the bottom.
我看到在下面有两颗门牙。
I think you will have two front upper teeth soon.
我想你很快就会有两颗在上面的门牙。
Mommy will brush your teeth, sweetie.
Oh my! You drool too much, honey.
喔！宝贝，你流太多口水了。
You've gotten a rash from all that drooling.
你流这么多的口水，长疹子了。
Do you think you can stand up now, baby?
宝贝，你想你现在能站得起来吗？
Don't give up. You are almost there.
That's right. You are doing great!
Don't let go of Mommy's hands.
Be careful. You might fall down.
Doesn't it hurt? Are you okay?
Don't cry. It's all right. We'll try one more time.
不要哭。没事的。我们再试一次。
It's time for your meal, sweetie.
You must be hungry. Let's eat now.
你一定很饿了。我们现在就来吃吧。
What will we have to eat today?
It is very delicious vegetable porridge.
Look! Isn't the color so pretty?
宝贝，好好享受你的饭饭。
Don't forget to chew before you swallow.
吞下去之前，别忘了嚼一嚼。
Wow, you can chew really well.
You got food all over your face. Let me wipe it off for you.
你满脸都是食物。我帮你擦掉。
No, no! Don't eat food that has fallen on the floor.
